title: HireMe.gg
tagline: Hireme.gg is a decentralized protocol that connects the supply of labour to demand, without middlemen in a fair and secure environment.  Our smart contract handles payments, while our arbitration system resolves any disputes.
description:
Introducing Hireme.gg, the worlds decentralised work market place.  

Where we connect the best businesses with the best independent talent. 

In ultra low fee, highly secure, completely decentralized environment.

Whether you're a fortune 500 company, a new startup or an army of 1.  Hire me, the worlds decentralized work market place is where a global on demand workforce helps both businesses and independent talent succeed together.


Walk through:

To get started visit Hireme.gg and connect your metamask.

To get 100 free Hire tokens, the tokens you need to create and propose jobs, connect with your Lens handle.

What’s lens? Well, It’s a permissionless, non-custodial, social media profile. 

With Lens Protocol, you are in control. You own your profile, where you use it, how you use it, and even how you monetize it. Giving you the power over your content and identity. 

Once you connect with your Lens NFT, we’ll ask you to register, for free, in exchange for your first 100 Hire tokens.  

You can then complete your profile and start exploring the application.

To add a job, navigate to the jobs board and select ‘add new job’ where you can then fill out the job specifications and contract details.

Once submitted you will be able to view proposals within the job detail, where you can review and accept or decline the proposal.

To make your own proposal, navigate to the jobs board and select a job that interests you. 

You can then review the job details and client history, add to favourites or submit a proposal.

You can keep track of your jobs and proposals in your profile.

Upon a job's completion, if all parties agree the work is done HireMe’s smart contracts will automatically handle payment and hand over. 

If there is disagreement, arbitration will be triggered with Kleros, a decentralized arbitration service.

Our stack is completely decentralized, we store the jobs metadata on IPFS, the user profile on Ceramic, and the funds are escrowed in our smart contract.

Going forwards we want to add support for more identity solutions, bright ID, Proof of humanity, etc... And build out Hire Me’s own arbitration system.

For further information on the project please check out our FAQ’s or get in touch via discord.
how_its_made:
For the frontend client of our dapp we used next.js and tailwind css, the frontend it's deployed on vercel

to store the jobs metadata we are using IPFS, and then we store the IPFS hash on our smart contract

the user profile data it's stored on Ceramic

our smart contracts are developed with Solidity using Hardhat as devtooling

our dapp integrats Lens Protocol social graph
